text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Akadan Bulk - (built 1978) sold to Spanish buyers $4 million.
Reliance I - (built 1983) 34,913 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $6.5 million on "as is" basis.
TANKERS - Eagle Orion - (built 1989) sold to Far Eastern buyers for $30 million.
TWEENDECKERS - Libra - (built 1985) 4,100 dwt sold to Danish buyers $3.6 million.
REEFERS - Ionian Sprinter - (built 1975) 6,057 dwt sold to mortgagees for $1.3 million at auction in Rotterdam.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Elena V - (built 1973) 39,893 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $171 per ldt.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
